headline: Architectural Design Services Preparation Checklist — Los Angeles
articleBody:
Architectural Design Services Preparation Checklist for Los Angeles Clients

Before your Architectural Design Services appointment with Opus Builders, make sure you have the following ready:

1. Measurements
2. Budget
3. Design preferences
4. Permits needed
5. Material selections

Contact Opus Builders at (818) 939-8855 to get started.
